maddeler.e:
نعتصر (form VIII)
# نَعْتَصِرُ (naʕtaṣiru) /naʕ.ta.sˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# نُعْتَصَرُ (nuʕtaṣaru) /nuʕ.ta.sˤa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# نَعْتَصِرَ (naʕtaṣira) /naʕ.ta.sˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# نُعْتَصَرَ (nuʕtaṣara) /nuʕ.ta.sˤa.r
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
